Santa Energy

Posts no per-gallon price online. Four pricing plans plus an 11-payment budget plan, and a discount for paperless ACH payers. Source, read 2026-11-19.

Pricing model

Daily Price: the rate on the day of delivery, with no enrollment form or fee; Santa says over 70% of its customers use it. Fixed Price: a locked price for the season. Capped Plan: a not-to-exceed price, and you pay the lower daily price if it falls below the cap; there is a fee, which Santa does not publish. Pre-Buy: a fixed price at a lower rate, paid in full before the season. All price protection plans expire on 30 April.

What its own pages say

Even Pay Budget spreads delivery costs over 11 monthly payments. Customers who take paperless email statements and pay by automatic ACH within seven days of delivery get a $0.15/gal discount. Family-owned, based in Bridgeport, serving Fairfield and New Haven Counties since 1940.

How this listing was built

Read from Santa Energy's oil pricing and payment options page and its homepage. Nothing on this page is estimated: where the dealer does not publish a figure, none is given. Ask for a quote at www.santaenergy.com/heating-oil/pricing-payment-options and compare it with your state's EIA average.
